text: Implemented typed edge normalizers inner_product, population covariance, cosine, and correlation with explicit zero policies; typed Fisher and rank transforms with boundary/tie policies; and distinct edge-first versus aggregate-first weighted reducers. Added four lowering classifications, sparse/dense physical query equivalence with required coordinate/side diagnostics, stable extreme-scale normalized evaluation, conservative lowering-specific memory plans, public Rd docs, and compiler task/scientific-plan identity coverage for every stage and policy. Independent operation oracles, correlation/Fisher noncommutativity, boundary, ties, invalid-policy, and memory tests pass. Full testthat suite: 963 assertions. Source tarball and vignettes built; R CMD check --as-cran exited 0 with only new-submission/version and local outdated HTML Tidy NOTEs. git diff --check clean.
